{
  "thinking": "Leo asked me to hold the belly line while he carries the spine on toward the nose. My hands are free, but building now could tangle with his extension, so I'll wait for his go-ahead.",
  "say": "Got it, Leo. I'm holding the belly line. Shout when the spine's through and I'll run it from the bottom of the body back to the tail tip.",
  "to": "everyone",
  "eagerness": 3,
  "point": [8, 10],
  "do": "stop",
  "notes": "Fish, tail left. START at tail tip (~x5 y10), fall runs right to the nose. Pad strokes: 1 = spine (start to nose), 2 = middle line, 3 = top body, 4 = bottom body, 5 and 6 = tail fork. Roles: Leo traces 1 (spine), extending it now from the bend near (8,10). Tom takes fork 5 and 6 (closing a gap near the middle, then stroke 5). Maya takes top body 3 and bottom body 4 (branching off the spine once it's through). Maya holds the pad; don't take it unless she gives it. I take the belly line: bottom body join back to the tail tip, plus joins and fixes at the fork once the spine is down. Holding until Leo says the spine is through. Chain breaks to recheck after that: near (9,12), (9,11.5), (8,9). Around 2:30 with 7.5 minutes left."
}
